gitaVerses.sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana |
mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stvakarmaṇi ||
gitaVerses.english: You have a right to perform your prescribed duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of actions. Never consider yourself to be the cause of the results of your activities, nor be attached to inaction.
gitaVerses.theme: Focus on the Process, Release Anxiety of Outcome

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
yoga-sthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya |
siddhy-asiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga ucyate ||
gitaVerses.english: Perform your duty equipoised, O Arjuna, abandoning all attachment to success or failure. Such equanimity is called Yoga.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते।
सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
dhyāyato viṣayān puṁsaḥ saṅgas teṣūpajāyate |
saṅgāt sañjāyate kāmaḥ kāmāt krodho 'bhijāyate ||
gitaVerses.english: While contemplating the objects of the senses, a person develops attachment for them, and from such attachment lust develops, and from lust anger arises.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः स शान्तिमधिगच्छति॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
vihāya kāmān yaḥ sarvān pumāṁś carati niḥspṛhaḥ |
nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ sa śāntim adhigacchati ||
gitaVerses.english: A person who has given up all desires for sense gratification, who lives free from desires, who has given up all sense of proprietorship and is devoid of false ego—attains true peace.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर।
असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
tasmād asaktaḥ satataṁ kāryaṁ karma samācara |
asakto hy ācaran karma param āpnoti pūruṣaḥ ||
gitaVerses.english: Therefore, without being attached to the fruits of activities, one should act as a matter of duty, for by working without attachment one attains the Supreme.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
na hi jñānena sadṛśaṁ pavitram iha vidyate |
tat svayaṁ yoga-saṁsiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati ||
gitaVerses.english: In this world, there is nothing so sublime and pure as transcendental knowledge. Such knowledge is the mature fruit of all mysticism.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet |
ātmaiva hy ātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ ||
gitaVerses.english: One must elevate oneself by one's own mind, not degrade oneself. The mind is the friend of the conditioned soul, and its enemy as well.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
bandhur ātmātmanas tasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ |
anātmanas tu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatru-vat ||
gitaVerses.english: For him who has conquered the mind, the mind is the best of friends; but for one who has failed to do so, his mind will remain the greatest enemy.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
yathā dīpo nivāta-stho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā |
yogino yata-cittasya yuñjato yogam ātmanaḥ ||
gitaVerses.english: As a lamp in a windless place does not flicker, so the disciplined mind of a yogi engaged in meditation on the Self remains steadily focused.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
yato yato niścarati manaś cañcalam asthiram |
tatas tato niyamyaitad ātmany eva vaśaṁ nayet ||
gitaVerses.english: From wherever the mind wanders due to its flickering and unsteady nature, one must certainly withdraw it and bring it back under the control of the Self.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
ananyāś cintayanto māṁ ye janāḥ paryupāsate |
teṣāṁ nityābhiyuktānāṁ yoga-kṣemaṁ vahāmy aham ||
gitaVerses.english: To those who always think of Me and worship Me without deviation, to them whose minds are always absorbed in Me, I provide what they lack and preserve what they have.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुremote क्तो यः स च मे प्रियः॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate ca yaḥ |
harṣāmarṣa-bhayodvegair mukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ ||
gitaVerses.english: He by whom no one is agitated and who is not agitated by the world, who is freed from excessive delight, envy, fear, and anxiety—he is dear to Me.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया।
विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā |
vimṛśyaitad aśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru ||
gitaVerses.english: Thus I have explained to you wisdom still more secret than all secrecy. Ponder it fully, and then act as you choose.

gitaVerses.sanskrit:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः।
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम॥
gitaVerses.transliteration:
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ |
tatra śrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama ||
gitaVerses.english: Wherever there is Krishna, the master of all mystics, and wherever there is Arjuna, the supreme archer, there will also certainly be opulence, victory, extraordinary power, and morality.
gitaVerses.theme: Harmony of Spiritual Clarity & Action in the World

thoughts.title: Chitta Vritti Nirodha (Calming the Mental Whirlpools)
thoughts.quote: योगश्चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधः — Yoga is the stilling of the fluctuations of consciousness.
thoughts.reflection: Your smartphone feeds your mind micro-waves of reactive outrage and novelty. Today, remember that focus is not the absence of thought, but the conscious choice of which single thought receives your energy. Practice single-tasking for the next 4 hours.

thoughts.title: Tat Tvam Asi (Recognizing the Infinite Within)
thoughts.quote: तत्त्वमसि श्वेतकेतो — You are That, O Shvetaketu.
thoughts.reflection: When external social comparison tries to measure your worth by follower counts or peer achievements, step back. Your fundamental consciousness is unborn, complete, and boundless. Work with joy from fullness, not from a sense of lack.

thoughts.title: Pratipaksha Bhavana (Countering Negative Impulses)
thoughts.quote: वितर्कबाधने प्रतिपक्षभावनम् — When negative or distractive thoughts arise, cultivate the opposite.
thoughts.reflection: When the urge to grab your phone strikes out of boredom, immediately counter it with a physical pause: take three deep conscious breaths and remind yourself of the high-value project you are building today.

thoughts.title: Abhyasa and Vairagya (Practice and Detachment)
thoughts.quote: अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते — The restless mind is curbed by relentless practice and non-attachment.
thoughts.reflection: Skill in engineering and peace in life do not arrive magically; they are forged through daily incremental practice (abhyasa) and the courage to release non-essential drama (vairagya).

thoughts.title: Aham Brahmasmi (The Radiance of Inner Strength)
thoughts.quote: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि — I am the Divine Reality.
thoughts.reflection: You carry within you the creative potential of the entire cosmos. Do not diminish yourself into a passive consumer of algorithmic feeds. Be a creator, a problem solver, and an instrument of clarity.

mantras.name: Gayatri Mantra
mantras.sanskrit: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥
mantras.transliteration: oṁ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ | tat savitur vareṇyaṁ | bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
mantras.meaning: We meditate upon the supreme effulgence of that luminous creator (Savitur) who pervades the physical, subtle, and celestial realms. May that Divine Light illuminate and awaken our intellect.
mantras.benefit: Awakens cognitive clarity, dispels intellectual fog, and sharpens analytical intuition.

mantras.name: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra
mantras.sanskrit: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्। उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृremote त्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात्॥
mantras.transliteration: oṁ tryambakaṁ yajāmahe sugandhiṁ puṣṭi-vardhanam | urvārukam iva bandhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya māmṛtāt ||
mantras.meaning: We revere the Three-Eyed Lord Shiva, the fragrant nourisher of all beings. As a ripe melon effortlessly detaches from its vine, may we be freed from fear, limitation, and mortality into immortality.
mantras.benefit: Instills deep fearlessness, resilience against life's storms, and emotional grounding.

mantras.name: Shanti Patha (Universal Peace Invocations)
mantras.sanskrit: ॐ असतो मा सद्गमय। तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय। मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय। ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥
mantras.transliteration: oṁ asato mā sad gamaya | tamaso mā jyotir gamaya | mṛtyor mā amṛtaṁ gamaya | oṁ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
mantras.meaning: Lead me from ignorance to Truth; lead me from darkness to Light; lead me from mortality to Immortality. Om, Peace, Peace, Peace.
mantras.benefit: Sets a serene tone for the entire morning, cleansing anxiety and restlessness.

mantras.name: Om Namah Shivaya (Panchakshari Mantra)
mantras.meaning: I bow to Shiva—the purest inner Consciousness that resides peacefully in the silence beyond thoughts.
mantras.benefit: Directly harmonizes the five elements within the body and steadies the nervous system.
